#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed StarRupture server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/starrupture/gamedash-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/starrupture" "gdtest" "300" <<'SESSION'
import glob, json, os, sys
root, session, interval = sys.argv[1:4]
saves = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(root, "StarRupture", "Saved", "SaveGames", "**", "*.sav"),
                         recursive=True), key=os.path.getmtime)
d = {"SessionName": session, "SaveGameInterval": interval,
     "StartNewGame": "false" if saves else "true",
     "LoadSavedGame": "true" if saves else "false",
     "SaveGameName": os.path.basename(saves[-1]) if saves else "AutoSave0.sav"}
json.dump(d, open(os.path.join(root, "DSSettings.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8"), indent=2)
SESSION
export WINEPREFIX="<ROOT>/home/.wine-gd-starrupture-test"
export WINEDEBUG=-all
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="   # no Mono/Gecko install prompts (headless)
# Run headless: Wine would otherwise open a console window on the desktop
# session (unsetting DISPLAY alone isn't enough — it falls back to Wayland).
unset DISPLAY
export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-none
cd "<ROOT>/installs/starrupture/" || exit 1
exec wine ./StarRupture/Binaries/Win64/StarRuptureServerEOS-Win64-Shipping.exe -gamedash=test -Log -Port=7777 -RCWebControlDisable -RCWebInterfaceDisable
